items.title: Anthony: job scheduled, then reported finished
items.summary: Pourya pressed Anthony for an update and a finish this week; after a back-and-forth the owner's preferred time was agreed (3pm). Anthony later said he was finished on site and sent a photo; Pourya said he was passing it to the owner.

items.title: Luxevista: loose area on site, photos exchanged
items.summary: Pourya sent photos of a loose area and asked Luxevista whether to go fix it that day or look first. Luxevista replied with photos and a 'Done' message.

items.title: Supplier pickup: Joey collecting 705 stock at SIDCO
items.summary: Supplier pickup: Joey asked SIDCO to hold 26 boxes of 705 for pickup on 10-30 (Angad said sure), then said he was coming that evening and asked them to prepare it; Angad confirmed.

items.title: Supplier order: Joey reserves 27 more boxes of 705 at SIDCO
items.summary: Supplier order: Joey asked SIDCO to reserve another 27 boxes of 705 for a customer and noted a possible further ~600-650 sq ft that is unconfirmed with a later timeline. Angad agreed and offered to reserve the extra as well. No pickup message yet.

items.title: Supplier inquiry: SIDCO beige matte 1224 options
items.summary: Other: the shared inbox (sender unknown) asked SIDCO what beige matte 1224 options they have for about 100 sf; Angad replied with a photo.

items.title: Payment: SIDCO confirms cash received
items.summary: Payment: after the shared inbox told SIDCO they could collect cash before 1, SIDCO posted a receipt note for $7630 on 30 Oct.
